review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Purpose Responsible for designing, planning, and supervising the implementation of irrigation networks and wet utility infrastructure across agricultural farms, ensuring efficient water distribution, proper system performance, and compliance with approved technical standards and project requirements. Key Responsibilities Design irrigation networks for agricultural farms based on crop requirements, water availability, and site conditions. Prepare irrigation network layouts, hydraulic calculations, pipe sizing, and pressure requirements. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering. Proficiency in AutoCAD; knowledge of Civil 3D or relevant irrigation design software is an advantage.
